d: Some careers grow faster than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

Global Trade & Receivables Finance (GTRF) is part of HSBC’s Global Trade Solutions business, providing trade finance, supply chain finance and receivables finance solutions to clients worldwide. With over 5,000 Trade experts, GTRF facilitates approximately USD740 billion of trade annually and supports customers from SMEs to large corporates and multinationals.

To drive revenue growth and relationship depth by managing a portfolio of corporate clients and delivering tailored trade, supply chain and receivables finance solutions. The role will identify new business opportunities, increase wallet share and support structured working-capital solutions in collaboration with internal stakeholders.

r: Drive revenue growth through working-capital management products and services.
Retain and increase wallet share across existing clients and group companies.
Identify opportunities to sell additional GTS products and generate new income.
Develop strategies to win new-to-bank and new-to-trade clients.
